name: How It Works 3
description: Four full-viewport gradient step cards pin with position:sticky and squash away (scale to 0.70, rotateX to 27deg, per-card rotateZ tilt, late opacity fade) over a 942px pin while the next card slides over.
interactions: sticky-pin squash stack: each .scs-slide is 100vh + 942px tall (last 100vh), card is position:sticky top:0; per-card progress p = (scrollY - slideTop) / 942 clamped 0..1.35
card transform (verbatim from reference): scale = 1 - 0.3*p^2 (1 -> 0.70), rotateX = 27deg * p^1.6 (no perspective), rotateZ = per-card tilt * p^2 with tilts -3.5 / 0 / +4.3 / 0 deg (data-tilt)
card opacity: 1 until p ~0.85, fades linearly to 0 by p ~1.3 (continues past pin end); last card never shrinks

word flash-in: words hidden only once JS runs, revealed via opacity transition 0.12s linear with 70ms/word inline transition-delay when the block top crosses 75% of viewport height (checked from the update loop, no IntersectionObserver)
Get started button: per-letter roll-up on hover, two stacked char rows shift by one line-height (--font-lh-btn-md), transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.6,0,0.2,1) with 18ms/char transition-delay
dual drive: passive scroll listener + requestAnimationFrame loop (rAF dies in hidden docs, scroll covers embeds)
prefers-reduced-motion: transforms, flash hide, char roll and rAF loop all skipped; content rendered in final state

layout.container: 1200px centered title + card content, cards full-bleed 100vh
